original_answer.meaning_zh: 将干净衣服与脏衣服分开
original_answer.example_en: We separate clean clothes from dirty ones.
original_answer.example_zh: 我们把干净衣服和脏衣服分开放。
collocations: separate clean clothes from dirty clothes
original_answer.usage_note: separate A from B指将两类东西分开。

revised_answer.example_en: We separate clean clothes from dirty ones.
revised_answer.example_zh: 我们把干净衣服和脏衣服分开放。
collocations: separate clean clothes from dirty clothes
revised_answer.usage_note: separate clean clothes表示将干净衣物区分开；要明确与脏衣物分开，需补充from dirty clothes。

original_answer.example_en: I used a cable organizer to keep the cords together.
original_answer.example_zh: 我用了一个理线器把电线整理在一起。
original_answer.usage_note: cable organizer是泛指理线用品，不一定仅为夹子。

revised_answer.example_en: I used a cable organizer to keep the cords together.

original_answer.example_en: We're almost out of laundry detergent.
original_answer.example_zh: 我们的洗衣液快用完了。
original_answer.usage_note: laundry detergent专指洗衣用的洗涤剂，可为液体或粉末。

revised_answer.meaning_zh: 洗衣用洗涤剂；洗衣液或洗衣粉
revised_answer.example_en: We're almost out of laundry detergent.
revised_answer.example_zh: 我们的洗衣用洗涤剂快用完了。
revised_answer.usage_note: laundry detergent泛指洗衣用洗涤剂，可以是液体或粉末，liquid laundry detergent才特指洗衣液。

original_answer.example_en: This sweater came out of the wash with shrunk sleeves.
original_answer.example_zh: 这件毛衣洗完后，袖子缩水了。
original_answer.usage_note: shrunk是shrink的过去分词，指衣物尺寸因洗涤而缩小。

revised_answer.example_en: This sweater shrank in the wash, especially around the sleeves.
revised_answer.example_zh: 这件毛衣洗后缩水了，尤其是袖口附近。
revised_answer.usage_note: 日常英语更自然说shrunken clothes或clothes that have shrunk；原目标shrunk clothes是否应改词头须经Master审定。

original_answer.example_en: The red towel caused color bleed in the wash.
original_answer.example_zh: 红毛巾洗涤时掉色，导致衣物串色。
original_answer.usage_note: color bleed为衣物染料转移或掉色的表达；属待独立审核补缺候选。

revised_answer.example_en: The red towel caused color bleeding in the wash.
revised_answer.example_zh: 红毛巾在洗涤中掉色，导致串色。

original_answer.example_en: Take the laundry out as soon as the cycle finishes.
original_answer.example_zh: 洗衣程序结束就把衣物取出来。
collocations: take laundry out of the washer
original_answer.usage_note: take out表示从洗衣机中取出；此源项是待独立审核增补候选。

revised_answer.example_en: Take the laundry out as soon as the cycle finishes.

original_answer.example_en: Lentils cook well in a hearty soup.
original_answer.example_zh: 扁豆很适合用来做浓汤。
original_answer.usage_note: lentils是扁豆类食材，英语通常使用复数。
